description: Returns the shared Delx Wellness profile (~/.delx-wellness/profile.json). Read-only. Surfaces calorie/macro targets, dietary preferences, restrictions/allergies, and goals so nourish coach/suggest tools can personalize meals.

privacy_mode.description: summary = high-level totals without item detail; structured = default full JSON-friendly fields; raw = same as structured for this local store (parity).
